candidates.title: Draft a national exam and room schedule

demandEvidence.chore: Plan and coordinate national exams, including preparing exam schedules and booking rooms.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Planera, administrera och samordna nationella prov

ease.reason: A fictional exam list and room table could support a draft schedule, but no attached reference documents these mechanics.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a school might value less manual exam planning; this vacancy does not establish demand for an AI service.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock could draft from operator-entered test rows; real school rules and calendar access are absent.

autonomy.reason: A mock could arrange supplied slots, while staff must resolve conflicts and approve every room and exam assignment.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly names planning and coordinating national exams, but gives no workflow details.

candidates.reason: Assessed a fictional-input schedule draft for the concrete exam-planning chore; the equal-weight mean is 4.8, below threshold, because no attached reference supports scheduling mechanics and staff must resolve conflicts.

rejected.title: Draft a national exam and room schedule
rejected.reason: Below threshold: the notice establishes exam planning and room bookings, but no attached building reference supports schedule generation; a fictional-input mock still needs staff to resolve conflicts and approve assignments. Equal-weight mean: 4.8.

rejected.title: Handle school personnel and student administration
rejected.reason: Rejected as too broad: the notice describes personnel and student administration plus varied practical and administrative duties, without one bounded task to assess.

rejected.title: Coordinate a school administrator’s daily work
rejected.reason: Rejected as too vague: the notice describes parallel tasks and coordination but identifies no concrete chore for a scoped experiment.

steps.message: Reviewed all three selected education demand notices against the recent-post window. The exam-planning notice supports a specific chore but the proposed fictional-input schedule mock scores 4.8; the other two notices are too broad. No post proposed.
